name: Armor of the Spirit Elk (Minor Artifact)
body:
Slot armor; Aura strong necromancy; CL 20th; Weight 50 lbs.

DESCRIPTION

This armor looks like a rugged, primitive parody of plate armor forged from thick scrap metal and drowned in blood. What looks like ribs and parts of bone reinforce the armor in many places. The Armor of the Spirit Elk is a suit of +5 wild full plate that grants it wearer fast healing 10 that stacks with all other fast healing the owner has. Despite being made partly of metal, it can be worn by druids.

DESTRUCTION

The Armor of the Spirit Elk is destroyed if a Spirit Elk-Maddened creature wears it in an attempt to kill the Spirit Elk, but fails and is killed by the beast while wearing the armor.
